name: [Equip] Translation queue backlog > 50 for > 1 hour
message:
## Translation queue not draining

`equip.translation.queue_depth` (the count of `queued + failed` jobs eligible for re-claim) has been above 50 for the last hour. The worker isn't keeping up — either the cron tick frequency is too low (`*/1 * * * *` is the current schedule) or every claimed job is failing repeatedly.

## First-look triage

1. Check `equip.translation.queue_failed_permanent` on the dashboard — if THAT is climbing too, jobs are exhausting their attempt budget and getting dead-lettered. Look at the most recent `failed_permanent` row's `last_error` column.
2. Curl the health endpoint for the live snapshot:
   ```bash
   curl -H "X-Worker-Secret: $TRANSLATION_WORKER_SECRET" \
        https://api.equipbible.com/api/v1/internal/translation-queue/health
   ```
3. If everything looks healthy except the queue is just BIG (e.g. a bulk import dumped 200 courses), raise the cron frequency temporarily — `vercel.json::crons[0].schedule = "*/30 * * * * *"` (every 30 seconds).

## Why 50 / 1 hour

50 backlog at the current `1 minute` cron pace = ~50 minutes of work even if every tick succeeds. 1 hour evaluation window filters out bulk-import spikes (which drain in their own hour).
